rows.en: You've gotten better, haven't you? Taking on that many of them, you did well…

I'm so happy to hear you say that, Sharivan!!

Sharivan, there's something I want to show you. Look…

I'm going to plant this flag first of all, on Planet Iga…

Under this flag, everyone will join forces and work together… to rebuild Planet Iga!
I can hardly wait for that day…
Oh, that's right… I came to deliver this!

What a pretty ring…

But… I don't have time to dress up!
Sharivan… You were worried about me?
They'll come after you again! You'd better wear it, just to be safe.
Never mind, never mind… Just follow me and don't ask!
Hmm… So you've got a good side to you after all, eh?
While you're at it, isn't there something you can do about that guy's tab…?
Go on… You can eat all of this!
Hmm… Why don't you ask your own palms?
The skin on your palms is all peeled like that… You work so hard, Helen. This is your reward!
Well, well… So this is what was going on?

What…!?

Captain… You're way too generous when you don't even have any money!

Look, with everyone fighting day in and day out, they hardly ever get to go shopping, right?

Annie's going out of her way for Mari's sake too. I figured they could use a break once in a while…

I guess you're right…

Understood! Here, use it…
All riiight, where are we going next? You can buy anything you like!
Just what I'd expect from Captain Gavan… You're so reliable.

Oh, leave it to me! I've got all the money in the world. You'd be surprised how much a riding club makes!

Sharivan! I'll pay for this place. Well then…

Hee hee… Everyone looked like they were having fun.

Sharivan… thank you for today… I really had fun!
Listen, Helen… Never open that door for anyone but me.

If anything happens, use the transmitter!

Well then…

(He's just like a big brother. So kind, so dependable…

I can't wait to go… to Planet Iga!)
Ha ha ha… Found you at last! Bell Helen!! Eliminate her!!
Helen… You'll be fine, I promise! Hang in there, Helen!!

Planet Iga… The Z flag is fluttering in the wind…

The sun is rising… The morning light… is so bright…

Helen!! Heleeen!!

I wanted to take you there. To Planet Iga… Helen!!

Come out!! Come out!! Madouuuuu!!
Seen off by her many comrades, the woman warrior who had raced across the battlefield fell into eternal sleep. Bell Helen, rest in peace!
The warriors left behind turned their sense of loss into rage, and strengthened their resolve to defeat their sworn enemy all the more…

Grr… Damn that Sharivan…!

But… Tactician Raider has finished off the woman space warrior! Ha ha ha…
Defeat Demon Beast Gori Beast and all Fightlow Soldiers!
Defeat General Guiler and all Fightlow Soldiers!
Den Iga or Bell Helen is defeated

O Emperor, who dwells in our distant homeland… the Crisis Empire!

At last, preparations for the invasion of Earth are complete! However, on Earth there are many defense organizations, starting with the Kamen Riders!

I beseech you, so that I may defeat them… grant me greater power than I have now…
Jark, my subordinate and my Supreme Commander!

Very well…

Fight to your heart's content… and claim victory!
